core.notes:
Profile Sync now records each partner's last action (Partner Last Actions: every resource and XP line, with its tax), read from what the game's sidebar already holds, never asked for
Cost Tables: Partner level EXP now starts from the average of all your partners' skills instead of the single lowest one, and shows Lowest, Average and Highest beside the Target box
Sculpture Grid Labels: Emptying the grid now clears the overlay, and a grid with only a few sculptures shows just their labels, instead of keeping the old ones
